Subject: Initial scope + request for consolidated ownership and 24-week timeline

Hi Vivek —

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We reviewed the integration checklist internally and we think a concise ownership matrix and a 24-week timeline that maps milestones to owners would help us get procurement and exec alignment. Could Redwood share a single-sheet deliverable that shows:

- Major milestones (discovery, infra prep, integration, test, pilot, rollout) with week ranges
- Primary owner (Redwood) and secondary owner (Brightside) for each milestone
- Key dependencies (SSO, data contracts, SOC 2 evidence) and sign-off gates

We have a target go-live window in late September and procurement has asked for the vendor form and an initial implementation calendar this week. Attaching our requirements doc (short).

Attachments: Brightside-Requirements-v2.pdf (11 pages)

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that speeds things up.

Elena Morales
Head of Product, Brightside AI
elena@brightside.ai

Elena —

Appreciate the clear ask and the requirements doc. We've pulled a draft ownership matrix and an initial 24-week plan together (attached) that maps owners, week ranges, and critical dependencies. High level notes:

- We propose a 24-week phased plan targeting a late-Sept pilot, with two parallel tracks: integration (APIs & SSO) and infra/cost tuning (quantization & model selection).
- SOC 2 evidence: Marissa will share our standard SOC 2 artifact packet and a short gap list for any additional items you flagged.
- Procurement: if you can loop in the procurement contact, we’ll route the vendor form and provide a redlines-ready contract summary.

Proposed kickoff: Tue 2027-03-16 10:00–11:00 PT or Wed 2027-03-17 09:00–10:00 PT — which works for your team?

Next steps I propose from our side:
1) Internal owners confirm the matrix (Marissa / Ben assign owners to each milestone).
2) Deliver updated artifact to your procurement by EOD Wed.
3) Lock kickoff and share agenda.

Attached: RDW-24wk-plan-v0.1.xlsx

-Vivek

2) Infra & capacity prep (W3–W4): R: Infra Eng (Marissa), B: Alec Turner — deliverable: GPU reservation, network access

4) Data contracts & provisioning (W7–W10): R: Integrations (Ben), B: Data Eng (Brightside) — deliverable: ingestion pipeline validation
5) End-to-end integration + QA (W11–W16): R: Ben (QA lead), B: Product Eng (Brightside) — deliverable: regression + load test reports
6) Pilot & metrics validation (W17–W20): R: CSM (Monica), B: Product + Ops — deliverable: pilot success criteria signed
7) Gradual rollout & monitoring (W21–W24): R: Monica (ops cadence), B: Operations — deliverable: rollout checklist, SLO dashboards

Key dependencies: SOC 2 artifacts (Marissa), procurement packet (Vivek), firewall rules (network team)

I'll incorporate your requirements doc into the plan and push v0.2 after a quick sync with Marissa.

-ben
